title: Matamshi Bora: Vokali na Konsonanti za Kiswahili (Theme 2: Shambani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child says each sound, not the letter name, and asks "one sound or two?" before counting consonants.

floor.prerequisite: Says the five vowels in order.
floor.question: Taja irabu za Kiswahili.

representations: vowel and consonant baskets with letter cards
a mirror for the mouth shapes
a sound chart of the alphabet with sh, ch, ny, ng' on single cards
steps: If not, is it one consonant written with two letters?
contexts: shambani: names of crops (mahindi, maharagwe, mtama)

board.say: Hii ni sauti moja au mbili?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child sorts six letter cards into vowels and consonants and says each.

listen_for: a, e, i, o, u, y
misconceptions.repair: Kiswahili kina irabu tano tu: a, e, i, o, u.

misconceptions.ask: Unasikia sauti moja au mbili mwanzoni?
misconceptions.repair: "sh" ni sauti moja, ingawa ina herufi mbili.

misconceptions.ask: Hili ni jina la herufi kwa Kiingereza au sauti yake kwa Kiswahili?

misconceptions.repair: Ng'ombe: sauti ng' bila /g/; ngoma: ng yenye /g/.
